def calculate_minimum_tour_length(N, X):
    # Initialize the minimum tour length to a large value
    min_tour_length = float('inf')
    
    # Calculate the total length of the tour without closing any bridge
    total_length = sum(abs(X[i] - X[i-1]) for i in range(1, N))
    
    # Iterate over each bridge (between islands i and i+1)

        # Calculate the tour length if the bridge between X[i] and X[i+1] is closed
        closed_bridge_length = total_length - abs(X[i] - X[i-1]) - abs(X[i+1] - X[i]) + abs(X[i+1] - X[i-1])
        
        # Update the minimum tour length if a shorter tour is found
        min_tour_length = min(min_tour_length, closed_bridge_length)

```python
def calculate_minimum_tour_length(N, X):
    # Initialize the minimum tour length to a large value
    min_tour_length = float('inf')
    
    # Calculate the total length of the tour without closing any bridge
    total_length = sum(abs(X[i] - X[i-1]) for i in range(1, N))
    
    # Iterate over each bridge (between islands i and i+1)
    for i in range(1, N-1):
        # Calculate the tour length if the bridge between X[i] and X[i+1] is closed
        closed_bridge_length = total_length - abs(X[i] - X[i-1]) - abs(X[i+1] - X[i]) + abs(X[i+1] - X[i-1])
        
        # Update the minimum tour length if a shorter tour is found
        min_tour_length = min(min_tour_length, closed_bridge_length)
    
    return min_tour_length
```
